Good to know

Frequently asked questions.

Is the course suitable for beginners?+

Yes. It starts with stock market fundamentals before moving into business quality, valuation, technical analysis, and portfolio management.

Do I need to know how to read financial statements?+

No prior expertise is required to start. The course introduces the key concepts you need to begin examining company financials.

Are the investing tools included?+

Yes. The course offer includes access to an intrinsic value calculator and an economic moat analyzer.

Is this a stock-picking or trading signals service?+

No. The goal is to teach you a research process so you can make informed decisions independently. It does not guarantee investment returns.
